body:
## Research on #1590

### Answers to open questions

**1. Can `2D Adaptive` (`Method = Trochoidal`) replace `Trochoidal slot` today?**
No. It cannot replace authored straight slots.
Two updates landed on `main` after `#1509`:
- `#1587` (`docs/decisions/1587-trochoidal-multi-lane.md`, `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive_troch_lanes.rs`) added parallel lanes, island rings, and corner clean-up to `2D Adaptive` (`Method = Trochoidal`).
- `#1588` (`docs/decisions/1588-adaptive-troch-params.md`, `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive_troch.rs`) added `max_engagement`, `loop_width`, `return`, and `return_feed` to `2D Adaptive` (`Method = Trochoidal`).

However, `OpParams::Adaptive2D` remains region-driven (`crates/app/src/operation/types/params.rs`, `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`).
It cannot cut an authored `(a, b, width)` channel across open `SrcRef::Stock`.
It cannot cut an authored channel across a whole model (`SrcRef::Entity`).
It also cannot cut a slot narrower than a selected floor face (`crates/app/src/operation/material_source.rs`).
In addition, `OpParams::TrochoidalSlot` exposes `smoothing` (Otkur & Lazoglu 2007, IJMTM 47; Rauch, Duc & Hascoet 2009, IJMTM 49; `crates/motion/src/machining2d/trochoid_slot.rs`).
`2D Adaptive` computes smoothing internally from `SMOOTH_PER_R` (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive_troch_lanes.rs`).

**2. What happens if we keep both as today (Option 1)?**
Users keep authored `(a, b, width)` trochoidal slots.
Two problems remain.
First, `KindInfo::ALL[40]` (`crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs`) sets `label: "Trochoidal slot"` and `caption: "Trochoid"`.
That ribbon caption reads like general trochoidal roughing instead of an authored straight slot.
Second, `#1523` remains open.
`OpParams::Slot` uses `SlotBound` (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/slot_room.rs`, `crates/app/src/operation/slot_pick.rs`).
`SlotBound` accepts two opposite straight edges or one face, and seeds `(a, b, width)`.
`OpParams::TrochoidalSlot` calls `refuse_unfit_slot` (`crates/app/src/operation/slot_fit.rs`).
`refuse_unfit_slot` rejects open edge picks and does not seed `(a, b, width)`.

**3. What does retiring and migrating old projects cost (Option 2)?**
Automatic migration covers only part of saved slots.
It also needs extra infrastructure:
- **Geometry gap:** Only a `TrochoidalSlot` with `SrcRef::Selection` whose face or ring matches the `(a, b, width)` stadium (`SLOT_FIT_TOL` in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/slot_room.rs`) equals a `2D Adaptive` region. Slots with `SrcRef::Stock`, `SrcRef::Entity`, or sub-face strips have no region equivalent.
- **Toolpath difference:** Even on a matched region, `trochoidal_slot` (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/trochoid_slot.rs`) differs from `adaptive_trochoidal_with` (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive_troch.rs`). `2D Adaptive` adds `WALL_MARGIN` erosion, Blum and Held medial-spine straightening (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive_troch.rs`), `optimal_load` step limits, fixed smoothing, and clean-up passes (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive_troch_clean.rs`).
- **Missing review state:** `Operation` (`crates/app/src/schema.rs`) has no `"needs review"` field. `OpStatus` (`crates/app/src/operation/types/sel.rs`) derives only `Never`, `Ok`, or `Stale` from `stamp`. `check_and_apply` (`crates/app/src/project/apply.rs`) returns `Vec<String>` load notes (`crates/ui/src/state.rs`). A blocking `"needs review"` state needs new schema, DTO, and UI work (shared with `#1517`).
- **Registry rules:** `Section::kinds` (`crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs`), ribbon buttons (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs`), retype menus (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/tree_menu.rs`), and MCP `list_operation_types` (`crates/app/src/mcp/job.rs`) read every row of `KindInfo::ALL`. `crates/app/tests/ribbon.rs` pins index `40` inside `Section::Mill2D`. Retiring needs a `retired` flag on `KindInfo`. Ordinal `40` and `ParamsDto::TrochoidalSlot` (`crates/app/src/project/trochoid_dto.rs`) must stay readable for old files.

**4. What happens if we keep the kind and rename it (Option 3)?**
Renaming pairs the operation with `Slot`.
It removes confusion with `2D Adaptive`.
Changing `KindInfo::ALL[40]` (`label` and `caption`) keeps `OpType::TrochoidalSlot` at ordinal `40`.
It also keeps the JSON tag `"trochoidal_slot"` (`crates/app/src/project/params.rs`, `crates/app/src/project/trochoid_dto.rs`).
Saved `.camproj` files open without migration.
A rename updates `KindInfo::ALL[40]`, `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/trochoid_slot_small.nc`, label checks (`crates/app/tests/trochoid_confine.rs`, `crates/app/tests/trochoid_law.rs`, `crates/app/tests/common/legacy_program.rs`), and docs (`site/content/guide/operations-2d.md`, `site/content/guide/operations.md`, `site/tests/test_operation_reference.py`).
MCP `kind_index` (`crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs`) already accepts `"trochoidal_slot"` from `kind_defaults`.
It can also keep `"Trochoidal slot"` as an alias.

---

### Design proposal

**Recommendation: Option 3 (keep the kind, rename it to pair with `Slot`, and unify `#1523`).**
`TrochoidalSlot` provides authored `(a, b, width)` straight-channel cuts that region-driven `2D Adaptive` cannot express.
Renaming it clarifies its role beside `Slot` and avoids lossy project migration.

1. **Smallest useful first slice (Option 3, Slice 1 — Rename and docs):**
   - Change `KindInfo::ALL[40]` (`crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs`) from `label: "Trochoidal slot"`, `caption: "Trochoid"` to `label: "Slot (Trochoidal)"`, `caption: "Slot Troch."`.
   - Keep `OpType::TrochoidalSlot`, ordinal `40`, and `ParamsDto::TrochoidalSlot` (`"trochoidal_slot"`) unchanged.
   - Update `site/content/guide/operations-2d.md` and `site/content/guide/operations.md` to direct region clearing to `2D Adaptive` (`Method = Trochoidal`) and authored straight channels to `Slot (Trochoidal)`.
   - Update `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/trochoid_slot_small.nc`, `crates/app/tests/trochoid_confine.rs`, `crates/app/tests/trochoid_law.rs`, `crates/app/tests/common/legacy_program.rs`, and `site/tests/test_operation_reference.py`.
   - Keep `"Trochoidal slot"` as a lookup alias in `crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs`.
2. **Second slice (Option 3, Slice 2 — Existing `#1523`):**
   - Route `TrochoidalSlot` picks through `operation::slot_bound_of` (`crates/app/src/operation/slot_pick.rs`) and `SlotBound::judge` (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/slot_room.rs`).
   - Both slot kinds then accept two opposite edges and seed `(a, b, width)`.

**Alternative proposal (if the maintainer chooses Option 2 — Retire and migrate):**
1. **Option 2, Slice A (Retire from creation surfaces):**
   - Add a `retired` flag on `KindInfo` (`crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs`) so `Section::kinds_for`, ribbon, retype menu, and MCP `list_operation_types` omit `OpType::TrochoidalSlot`.
   - Refuse new `CreateOperation` and MCP `add_operation` calls for `TrochoidalSlot` with a pointer to `2D Adaptive` (`Method = Trochoidal`).
   - Keep ordinal `40` and `ParamsDto::TrochoidalSlot` readable so old files still open and post.
2. **Option 2, Slice B (Conditional project migration):**
   - Convert saved `ParamsDto::TrochoidalSlot` ops to `OpParams::Adaptive2D` (`Method = Trochoidal`) on load only when `SrcRef::Selection` equals the `(a, b, width)` stadium within `SLOT_FIT_TOL`.
   - Mark `SrcRef::Stock`, `SrcRef::Entity`, and partial-face slots as `"needs review"` with `#1517`'s review mechanism.

---

### Proposed sub-issues

Sub-issues wait for maintainer approval on `#1590` (`P8`, no `needs-research`).

**If the maintainer approves Option 3 (recommended):**
1. **Title:** `Rename Trochoidal slot UI label and caption to pair with Slot`
   - **What it does:** Renames `KindInfo::ALL[40]` to `"Slot (Trochoidal)"` and `"Slot Troch."`, keeps `"trochoidal_slot"` project compatibility and MCP alias, and updates guide docs and label pins.
   - **Done means:** `KindInfo::ALL[40]` uses the new slot-first `label` and `caption`; saved `"trochoidal_slot"` files round-trip unchanged; `ribbon.rs`, `trochoid_op.rs`, `trochoid_confine.rs`, `trochoid_law.rs`, `trochoid_slot_small.nc`, and `test_operation_reference.py` pass.
   - **Proposed P:** `P6` | **Effort:** `effort:medium` | **Area:** `area:2d`, `area:ui`, `area:mcp`

2. **Title:** `One slot confine law for Slot and Trochoidal slot (existing #1523)`
   - **What it does:** Routes `TrochoidalSlot` picks through `operation::slot_bound_of` and `SlotBound::judge` so both slot kinds support two-edge picks and face-fit seeding.
   - **Done means:** One confine function serves both slot kinds, two-edge picks fit or refuse with the same numbers on both, and `#1503` and `#1504` pins pass.
   - **Proposed P:** `P7` | **Effort:** `effort:high` | **Area:** `area:2d`

**If the maintainer chooses Option 2:**
3. **Title:** `Retire Trochoidal slot from the ribbon and block new creation`
   - **What it does:** Hides `OpType::TrochoidalSlot` from `Section::kinds_for`, ribbon, retype menu, and MCP creation while keeping ordinal `40` and `ParamsDto::TrochoidalSlot` readable for saved projects.
   - **Done means:** `Section::Mill2D.kinds_for` and `list_operation_types` exclude `TrochoidalSlot`; `CreateOperation` and `add_operation` refuse it with a pointer to `2D Adaptive`; saved `TrochoidalSlot` projects open and post unchanged.
   - **Proposed P:** `P6` | **Effort:** `effort:medium` | **Area:** `area:2d`, `area:ui`, `area:mcp`

4. **Title:** `Migrate saved Trochoidal slot operations to 2D Adaptive (Trochoidal) where geometry matches`
   - **What it does:** Converts saved `TrochoidalSlot` operations to `Adaptive2D` (`Method = Trochoidal`) on load when `SrcRef::Selection` matches the `(a, b, width)` stadium, and marks unmatched slots `"needs review"` via `#1517`'s mechanism.
   - **Done means:** A saved project with a face-matched `TrochoidalSlot` opens as `Adaptive2D` (`Method = Trochoidal`) within engagement limits; `SrcRef::Stock`, `SrcRef::Entity`, and partial-face slots open marked `"needs review"` with a load note.
   - **Proposed P:** `P6` | **Effort:** `effort:high` | **Area:** `area:2d`
